summary: Iter 200: verified web Settings Family->Solo scheduled downgrade UI parity with mobile. Backend endpoints POST /payments/schedule-downgrade, POST /payments/cancel-scheduled-change validated (7/7 pytest pass). Web UI verified with seeded pending_plan: banner (billing-pending-change), Keep Family button (billing-keep-plan) that calls /payments/cancel-scheduled-change, and Scheduled state (billing-plan-scheduled-solo) on Solo plan card all render correctly. Confirmed Settings.jsx:385 wires Family->Solo to /payments/schedule-downgrade (NOT the legacy /billing/upgrade — that path remains only for upgrade). cathy's soloBlocked hint + disabled Switch button also verified (2 participants).
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx BillingTab is ~475 lines within a >900-line file. Consider splitting per-tab into separate files to keep bundles focused (Profile/Billing/Members/Digest etc.) — but not blocking.
keepCurrentPlan() has no confirmation dialog (unlike changePlan which uses window.confirm). Considered acceptable — 'Keep Family' reverses a scheduled change, no destructive action.

In BillingTab.changePlan(), when isDowngrade is true the plan-swap fallthrough on line 390 (/billing/upgrade) is unreachable (both branches guarded), which is correct — legacy path only fires for actual upgrades and same-plan clicks.
test_credentials: cathy@example.com / testpass123 (Family plan, 2 participants — soloBlocked verified). Seeded pending_plan=solo on cathy's db.subscriptions doc for banner verification, then cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded db.subscriptions {pending_plan:'solo', pending_effective:'2027-02-14T00:00:00+00:00', schedule_id:'sub_sched_TEST_iter200_ui'} on cathy's user to verify banner/scheduled state renders — CLEANED UP after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The web downgrade UI is fully wired per the spec and matches mobile parity. To exercise a REAL end-to-end schedule-downgrade against Stripe you need an account with a real stripe_subscription_id on a Family price — preview env doesn't have one. Use the DB-seed approach (see /tmp/seed_pending.py) to test the pending banner/keep-plan UI. cathy has schedule_id absent so cancel-scheduled-change returns 400 'No scheduled change to cancel.' unless seeded. The seeded schedule_id is fake so Stripe returns 502 on the release call — that's expected, the FE wiring is what matters.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature works as specified.
